name: 2 Kings
author: Not named in the text.
setting: Israel falls to Assyria in 722 BC and Judah falls to Babylon in 586 BC.
theme: Persistent covenant unfaithfulness ends in exile, yet a hint of hope remains for David’s line.

outline.label: Elijah taken up and Elisha’s mantle
Jehu to the fall of Israel

christInBook: Elisha’s miracles, including raising a child and feeding a crowd, prepare for the greater works of Jesus. Hezekiah and Josiah show reforming kings, but neither can finally save, and the book ends with a Davidic king still alive in exile, keeping hope open.
howToRead: This book moves quickly from king to king. Keep an eye on the prophets, who explain why events happen, and on the final chapters, where the exile is described as the covenant curse come true.
